headline: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb said on Thursday that Pakistan wants more foreign investment in Sukuk (Islamic bonds), as issuance rose to Rs4.4 trillion in 2026 from about Rs2 trillion last year, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Aurangzeb: Sukuk mein foreign investment abhi kam hai

caption:
Islami bonds (Sukuk) mein Rs4.4 trillion ka record!
Arab News ke mutabiq Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb ne Thursday ko Karachi mein kaha ke Pakistan chahta hai ke bahar ke investors Sukuk mein zyada paisa lagayein. 2026 mein Sukuk Rs4.4 trillion tak pohanch gaye, jabke pichle saal yeh taqreeban Rs2 trillion thay, yaani 113 percent izafa. Unhon ne kaha ke Sukuk mein foreign investment abhi bhi kam hai.
Kya aap Islami bonds mein paisa lagana pasand karenge? Comment mein batayein 👇
